facts.fact: Sponsored Display is now known as display ads
facts.quote: Sponsored Display is now known as display ads

facts.fact: Amazon introduced a single ad platform that connects display campaigns with customers across Amazon properties
facts.quote: introducing a single ad platform that connects your display campaigns with customers across Amazon properties

facts.fact: Display campaigns can reach audiences on Twitch, Fire TV, and Echo Show
facts.quote: across Amazon properties including Twitch, Fire TV, and Echo Show

facts.fact: Display campaigns can reach audiences on premium placements across the open internet
facts.quote: as well as premium placements across the open internet

facts.fact: Sponsored Display is now part of Amazon's wider display ads offering
facts.quote: Sponsored Display is now a part of Amazon's wider display ads offering

facts.fact: Amazon created a centralized hub that unifies access to all Amazon Ads products
facts.quote: within our new centralized hub that unifies access to all Amazon Ads products

facts.fact: The new hub brings together sponsored ads and Amazon DSP workflows into a single workspace
facts.quote: bringing together sponsored ads and Amazon DSP workflows into a single workspace

facts.fact: Existing Sponsored Display campaigns continue to run uninterrupted
facts.quote: Existing Sponsored Display campaigns will continue to run uninterrupted

facts.fact: Existing Sponsored Display campaigns are accessed through Campaign Manager in the Ads Console
facts.quote: access your existing Sponsored Display campaigns through Campaign Manager in the Ads Console

facts.fact: New display campaigns are created by clicking Campaigns, Create Campaign, and Display
facts.quote: create new display campaigns, go to Campaigns, click Create Campaign, and then click Display

facts.fact: Display ads are flexible ad formats that help brands reach relevant audiences
facts.quote: Display ads are flexible ad formats that can help your brand reach relevant audiences

facts.fact: Display ads can use Amazon-generated creative or custom creative assets
facts.quote: using Amazon-generated creative or your own creative assets
